title: The Morning Digest: November 8, 2026
dek: US Central Command said US forces disabled the St. Kitts-flagged bulk carrier M/V Huda in the Gulf of Oman on Nov 7, firing precision munitions at its stern after the crew ignored repeated warnings and tried several times to break the naval blockade after calling at an Iranian port. Twenty-one minutes later the IRGC announced two oil tankers had struck mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz; no vessel is named and no independent source has confirmed either tanker. The UAE National Guard rescued 22 crew from a cargo ship fire in the Sea of Oman, on a vessel it did not name and did not link to hostile action. The Qatari proposal reported Saturday would lift the blockade and release part of about $8 billion in frozen assets against IAEA inspections of Iran's bombed nuclear sites, with the strait reopening on day two through the route negotiated with Oman. Friday's settles stand: Brent Jan27 at $98.32 and WTI Dec26 at $90.83 (Bloomberg via Rigzone, Nov 6). December WCS is -$29.67 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 6) on zero lots. The validated diesel crack is $91.10.
